title: SYNERGY V1-V15 evidence and economic contribution ledger
method: Each version is classified by the strongest reusable contribution and by whether its reported PnL is admissible as external revenue in V15.2.

versions.strongest_contribution: Exact integer AMM accounting, timelocked policy/custody boundary, LP-recycling falsification.
Exclusive QE inventory auction thesis, solver bonding/commit-reveal, oracle and reserve guards.
Consolidated ledger, system boundary, haircut assets, stress liabilities, solvency/liquidity/gas/dividend gates.
exclude_from_revenue: modeled external PnL as a live forecast

versions.strongest_contribution: Real Liquidity Multiplier based on stress-equivalent executable depth and a single risk invariant.
Permissioned DEX, participant registry, restricted representative tokens, original-capital/profit separation and automatic compounding.
exclude_from_revenue: exogenous test revenue as recurring demand

versions.strongest_contribution: No-new-investor-capital self-support invariant with bounded keeper reimbursement and profit-only growth.
Complete permissioned four-asset graph, restricted public representative pool and hybrid internal/external route gate.
10x10 topology commitment, stateful controller and atomic QE/external-route/QT sequence.
exclude_from_revenue: claim that all ten internal pools were optimized

versions.strongest_contribution: Atomic flash-financing attempt and live-test failure evidence.

versions.evidence_class: negative empirical screen under simplified one-pool model
exclude_from_revenue: generalization from simplified one-pool assumption to full system

versions.strongest_contribution: Exact atomic one-pool temporary QE, external V3/V2 execution, buyback, full burn and k restoration.
Direct reserve burn/mint gradient and decisive consolidated accounting falsification.
exclude_from_revenue: 3237.964779 USDT wallet profit offset by LP loss

versions.strongest_contribution: 17.5M-configuration managed-gradient scanner, quote caching and 100-block opportunity discovery.
Strict stateful LP restoration and realized NAV benchmark.
versions.v15_2_role: binding accounting baseline and 2.68515 bps hurdle

versions.strongest_contribution: ExternalRevenueEngine, multi-adapter routes, solver auction, private RFQ and historical victim replay design.
versions.evidence_class: V15 legacy proof rejected; V15.1 source-immutable architecture not runner-executed

synthesis.economic_thesis: SYNERGY is strongest as an operating system that captures, verifies and compounds external surplus. Internal QE/QT is inventory and liquidity control, never revenue.
synthesis.binding_rule: No version-level wallet or module profit is admitted unless consolidated external NAV increases after all costs, LP damage and liabilities.
